summary: Frontend-only verification of three production fixes on Solarisound (mobile 375-390px). Issues 1, 2, and 3 all VERIFIED FIXED. Logged in as admin (Pro), reproduced each user flow end-to-end against the preview URL.

issue_1_notification_cta_starts_breathwo.evidence: Opened Notification Bell -> tapped 'A quiet moment awaits' -> reader panel -> tapped 'Take a breath together' CTA. Result: window.__audioEngine.playing=true, breathwork-overlay rendered, play-pause-button shows Pause glyph (rect icon), timer-display counting down. No further user tap required.

issue_2_affirmative_reply_auto_applies.evidence: Sent 'Can you play me some rain sounds?' -> LLM returned agent-suggestion-soundscape-0 (Rain). Sent 'yes' -> engine playing=true, ambient.rain.volume=0.6, ai-agent-sheet closed automatically. Also validated: regex correctly matches yes/sure/let's do it/go for it/sounds good/perfect/great AND rejects 'maybe later', 'no thanks', 'not now'.

issue_3_breathwork_mobile_no_overlap.evidence: pb-64 sm:pb-40 class applied on breathwork-overlay container. Actual breath-orb (parent of breath-phase) bottom=486px, timer-display top=531px -> gap=45px, NO overlap. Transport row parent has 'flex-wrap' so the Fading pill wraps or sits inline with timer. smart-fade-pill was visible in-frame alongside timer without collision.

regressions_checked.breathwork_toggle_button: Manually tapping data-testid=breathwork-toggle also works (verified via notification path which routes to startBreathworkFromNotification). Engine state transitions cleanly.
regressions_checked.aiagent_suggestion_tap: applySuggestion() still fires when a suggestion card is tapped directly (previous iteration coverage) and now ALSO fires via affirmative-reply guardrail when suggestions=[] in the follow-up.

ui_bugs.issue: Minor visual overlap between the frequency-name label ('Earth') coming from Visualizer and the breath-phase text ('HOLD') inside the orb — they render on nearly the same Y coordinate (~397px) at 375px width. Not part of the original reported Issue 3 but worth polishing.

integration_issues.issue: The _AFFIRMATIVE_RE regex uses ASCII apostrophe only (let'?s). iOS Safari + iOS keyboard auto-convert straight quotes to curly ones (U+2019). So a user who types 'Let’s do it' on iPhone would NOT match the regex and the auto-apply guardrail would silently fail — reproducing exactly the original bug for iOS users. Recommend widening the regex to accept both apostrophes: use `let[’']?s` (or normalise the text via .replace(/’/g, "'") before test).

critical_code_review_comments: AIAgentSheet.jsx: _AFFIRMATIVE_RE does not tolerate U+2019 (curly apostrophe). iOS auto-corrects straight ' to curly ’ on mobile, so mobile users tapping 'Let's do it' will still fall through to the LLM without triggering auto-apply. Fix: normalise input before regex test, or expand the character class.

Dashboard.jsx (line ~1934 transport area): flex-wrap is applied to timer container which is good; but the smart-fade-pill sits next to timer only when there's horizontal room. On 375px, both fit inline. Confirmed via bounding boxes.

React warning observed in console: 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' when clicking breathwork-toggle. Not blocking but indicates a setState-during-render somewhere in the toggle chain — worth chasing.
action_items: Widen AIAgentSheet _AFFIRMATIVE_RE to accept typographic apostrophe (U+2019) so iOS Safari users' auto-corrected 'Let’s do it' triggers the auto-apply guardrail. This is the same real-world bug users reported — just for iOS.

Investigate the React 'setState-during-render' warning fired on the breathwork-toggle click path (likely from a parent re-render inside toggleBreathwork's setBreathwork callback that also updates ambient state).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the three reported fixes; 1 iOS-apostrophe follow-up recommended

seed_data_creation: Used existing 'A quiet moment awaits' checkin notifications already present in the account (5 seeded). Did not create new data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 primary fixes work end-to-end via preview URL. The only follow-up is the iOS curly-apostrophe regex miss. Test method: login as admin@example.com (Pro), open Notification Bell, click 'A quiet moment awaits' -> reader -> 'Take a breath together' to reproduce Issue 1 in one path. For Issue 2, open Wellness Assistant, ask 'Can you play me some rain sounds?', then reply 'yes'. For Issue 3, measure actual orb (parent of [data-testid=breath-phase]) bbox vs timer-display bbox — do NOT measure the [data-testid=breathwork-overlay] container which uses inset-0 and always spans the whole visualizer.
rca_of_the_issue: Issues 1 & 2 were caused by the app narrating actions without actually invoking the audio engine after a user consent moment (notification tap or affirmative chat reply). Fix in Dashboard.jsx adds startBreathworkFromNotification called synchronously inside the notification-click gesture so iOS AudioContext.resume() is gesture-eligible. Fix in AIAgentSheet.jsx.send() detects affirmative replies (isAffirmative + lastActionableSuggestion) and calls applySuggestion() when the LLM confirmation returns no re-attached suggestion. Issue 3 was pure layout — pb-64 sm:pb-40 padding-bottom on the breathwork-overlay container shifts the flex-centered orb upward so the transport at bottom-6 has clear space. All three fixes are correctly deployed on the preview.
